fields.label: Item
fields.description: Free-text description of this commercial line item, e.g. 'Freight surcharge' or 'Sample fee'.

fields.label: Type
fields.options:
Actual
On Net Total
On Previous Row Amount
On Previous Row Total
On Item Quantity
fields.description: Actual: enter Amount / pc directly. On Net Total: Rate % of fabric+trims+CMT+testing (before other extra items/overhead). On Previous Row Amount: Rate % of one earlier row's own resolved amount (set Reference Row). On Previous Row Total: Rate % of the running total through that earlier row. On Item Quantity: Rate x quantity - this cost sheet is per-piece throughout, so quantity is always 1 here.

fields.label: Rate
fields.description: Percentage for On Net Total / On Previous Row Amount / On Previous Row Total. Flat per-piece rate for On Item Quantity. Unused for Actual.

fields.label: Reference Row
fields.description: 1-based row number of an EARLIER extra item row in this same table. Required for On Previous Row Amount / On Previous Row Total; unused otherwise.

fields.label: Amount / pc
fields.description: Entered directly for Actual rows. Computed and overwritten on save for every other Type.
